tools.name: search_lessons
tools.description: Search Digital Gemology's free gemology lessons by topic or question (for example 'how is diamond cut graded', 'moissanite vs diamond', 'what is a bow tie'). Returns each lesson's title, page, course, summary and quiz.

tools.name: get_lesson
tools.description: One lesson in full, as Markdown, with its page, course, quiz and the tools and cuts it uses. Give the lesson's page path or its title.

tools.name: explain_term
tools.description: What the lessons say about one gemology term (for example 'table', 'crown angle', 'fluorescence', 'girdle'): the passages that use it, each with the lesson it comes from.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: Every course and topic hub with its lessons, in order, with their pages.
